description.value:
Frequency once per day

As part of your daily preparations, you make a motivating speech to 10 or fewer allies. Your allies must be able to perceive you during this time, but this doesn't otherwise impede their own preparation. When one of these allies is reduced to 0 Hit Points and isn't immediately killed, you can call out to them to ignite their sense of duty. The creature avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 Hit Point, and its wounded condition increases by 1. Additionally, it gains a +5 foot status bonus to its Speed until the end of its next turn and a +1 status bonus to its first attack before the end of its next turn.
